course_title: Introduction to AI for Business Leaders
lesson_title: What is AI and Why it Matters for Business?

slides.heading: What is AI and Why it Matters for Business?
slides.content: Welcome to the first lesson. In this session, we will demystify the concept of AI in a way that is easy to understand from a management perspective, and decode why AI has become an indispensable strategic weapon in the digital era.
slides.image_keyword: Modern glowing AI brain connected to a global business network

slides.heading: Defining Artificial Intelligence (AI)
slides.content: Unlike traditional software systems that run on pre-programmed 'rules' (if/then logic), AI represents computer systems capable of performing tasks that typically require human intelligence (such as learning, reasoning, speech recognition, and self-correction).
bullet_points: It is not a single technology, but an ecosystem (Machine Learning, NLP, Vision...).
It is Data-driven rather than Rule-based.
It has the ability to improve over time as it is exposed to more data.
slides.image_keyword: Comparison between rule based code gears and a dynamic data driven neural network

slides.heading: Why is AI Important for Businesses Now?
slides.content: AI is no longer a sci-fi concept confined to laboratories. Leading organizations worldwide are leveraging AI to profoundly and comprehensively reshape their competitive advantage.
bullet_points: Cost Optimization: Automating highly repetitive tasks with high accuracy.
Revenue Growth: Personalizing the customer experience at an unprecedented depth.
Risk Management: Predicting and detecting fraud based on real-time behavior.

slides.heading: Leadership in the AI Era
slides.content: The manager's task is not to know how to program AI, but to know how to pose the right business problems for AI to solve.
slides.author: The Strategist's Perspective

slides.heading: Lesson Summary
slides.content: In this lesson, you grasped the core definition of AI and its role in shaping the business landscape.
bullet_points: AI fundamentally shifts how systems learn from data.
AI provides advantages in cost, revenue, and risk management.
The key to success is aligning business goals with technological capabilities.
